title: Fix Tree Items to Fill Panel Width
description: Fix the shared React tree/panel layout bug shown in CAD where tree items are constrained or clipped to the tab/content width instead of using the full available panel width. Diagnose the root layout constraint, extend existing tests, and verify the CAD runtime behavior.
summary: Fixed the shared React panel layout so tree content uses the full available panel width. Made the nested panel body stack and scroll viewport explicitly full-width and shrinkable, and extended the existing Panel regression test to cover the complete width chain.
